sections.text: Liebe Nachbarn, Dear neighbours, am Samstag ab neun Uhr kommen die Handwerker. Sie reparieren die Heizung im Keller. On Saturday from nine o'clock the workmen are coming. They will repair the heating in the basement. Von neun bis zwölf Uhr gibt es kein warmes Wasser. From nine to twelve there will be no hot water. Bitte stellen Sie keine Fahrräder und Kinderwagen vor die Kellertür. Please do not put bicycles or prams in front of the basement door. Vielen Dank für Ihr Verständnis! Thank you for your understanding! Ihre Hausverwaltung Your property management

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: A model text, written for this course. A real one names people: replace them with placeholders before you save it. Hausverwaltung : the company that looks after the building for the owner. Nothing to answer: keep the hall in front of the basement free on Saturday.
